aliases: Pro-forma for Record of Competency Assessment Results

one_line_answer.text: The pro-forma is an example form for the record of competency assessment results.

cites.quote: Example of a Pro-forma for Record of Competency Assessment Results

keywords.bn: আগে থেকে তৈরি ছক বা ফর্ম

bangla_explanation: এটা একটা example form, যেখানে assessment results record করা হয়।
উপরে assessor ও candidate-এর তথ্য, তারপর assessment arrangements যেমন pre meeting date, location, consumables।
মাঝে প্রতিটি unit of competency-র জন্য assessor comments আর competent/not yet competent লেখা হয়।
শেষে decision-এর narrative description, informal feedback, certificate recommendation আর assessor-এর signature with date।

example.en: After a plumbing assessment, the assessor fills the form. He writes 'Competent' for each unit and signs with the date.
example.bn: Plumbing assessment-এর পর assessor প্রতিটি unit-এ result লিখে তারিখসহ সই করেন।

items_bn: Assessor-এর তথ্য — নাম, institute বা প্রতিষ্ঠানের ঠিকানা, phone numbers আর email।
Candidate-এর তথ্য — নাম, institute, যোগাযোগের ঠিকানা, phone number আর email (যদি থাকে)।
Assessment-এর ব্যবস্থা — pre-meeting-এর তারিখ, actual assessment-এর দিন, location আর consumables।
কোন assessment activity করানো হলো, তার বিবরণ।
প্রতিটি unit of competency-র ফল — assessor comments আর competent/not yet competent।
Assessor নিজের ভাষায় (narrative description) লেখেন কেন এই decision নিলেন।
Assessment activity শেষে candidate-কে দেওয়া informal feedback লেখা থাকে।
সব documentation-এর কপি, আর certificate দেওয়ার recommendation বা non recommendation।
শেষে assessor তারিখসহ সই করেন, এতে record সম্পূর্ণ হয়।

short.prompt: List the sections of a record of competency assessment results.
short.modelAnswer:
A record of competency assessment results (pro-forma) has these sections:
1. Assessor.
2. Candidate.
3. Assessment arrangements.
4. Assessment activity.
5. Assessment results (unit, comments, competent/not yet competent).
6. Assessment decision.
7. Candidate feedback.
8. Recording of results.
9. Assessor's signature with date.

keyPoints.text: Arrangements include pre-meeting date, actual assessment, location and consumables.

cites.quote: ASSESSMENT ARRANGEMENTS Pre-meeting date: Actual assessment: Location: Consumables:

keyPoints.text: The decision section is the assessor's narrative description of the assessment decision.

keyPoints.text: Recording of results keeps copies of all documentation.

cites.quote: RECORDING OF RESULTS Copies of all documentation

checks.note: CBLM 12 never uses the term CARS. The paper-only card competency-assessment-result-summary (CARS, paper-short-questions q75) is a 'concise summary of assessment outcomes'. This p.28-29 pro-forma is a full record form, so it is kept as its own card rather than re-citing CARS. Owner to confirm whether the exam treats them as the same.
